verdict.rationale: LobeHub publishes a public changelog at lobehub.com/changelog, which covers one part of the story. Its entries are feature announcements, though, with no version numbers or self-host upgrade guidance. The 'Migrate from Local Database' page concerns moving client-side data, not update migrations, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: versioned release numbering tied to changelog entries, upgrade/migration notes for self-hosted Docker deployments, documented repair or rollback path when an update breaks, independent or hands-on corroboration of safe upgrades.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, updating is safe and documented — versioned releases with changelogs, migration notes, and a repair or rollback path when an update breaks

citations.quote: Gemini 3.6 Flash is now supported in LobeHub with four thinking levels, multimodal input, web search, and tool use.
Home is now a dashboard: a greeting and composer on one side, and a rail of cards on the other
